column2: Jump to a distant location using insect wings.

Inject royal jelly into a willing subject using a specialized injector organ. If the gene carrier's royal jelly is currently regenerating, the injection will not be possible. Injection causes a tiny wound, but when injected, the royal jelly grants the target an immunity boost and a mood boost.
Fly to a distant location that you can or cannot see using a set of gigantic locust wings. Allows the gene carrier to jump over the walls, provided the area they are jumping to is not roofed.
Insector charges towards the target, dealing significant damage to anything on the path. Will destroy any sort of defenses with ease.
Carriers of this gene have greenish blood color, just like insects.
Carriers of this gene have a slightly thicker carapace as their skin. Chitin plating is capable of deflecting sharp attacks, but is quite brittle and not as defensive against blunt trauma.
Carriers of this gene grow small antennae at the top of their head. These antennae do not serve any known function, and can be safely assumed to be cosmetic-only.
Carriers of this gene have special glands that allow them to greatly increase construction speed. They do however generate filth every time they construct anything.

Carriers of this gene have numerous independent photoreception units allowing them to see in many directions, notice very fast movements and recognize details from afar. Their sight and effective shooting range is greatly increased.
Carriers of this gene have a special vocal organ that can emulate human voice perfectly, and emit a melodic tone that for most people can be described as beautiful.
Carriers of this gene regenerate their tissue at a much faster rate than normal, and are much more capable of fighting off any infections and illnesses.

Carriers of this gene grow large insect-like wings at the back of their torso, allowing them to move quicker, glide through difficult terrain with ease, and from time to time enable them to leap into the air.
Carriers of this gene have very strong, insect-like mandibles, allowing them to consume food significantly quicker. They will also be able to use these mandibles in combat if unarmed.

Carriers of this gene grow a multi-fold midgut, allowing them to digest raw foods more efficiently than baseline humans. In general, they get the same nutrition from raw food as from if it is cooked. They also don't mind the taste of raw food at all. Prevents food poisoning.

Carriers of this gene are capable of absorbing new information at an incredible rate, analyzing their experiences and learning from them with ease. They are incredibly good at learning new skills and knowledge.

Carriers of this gene grow two strong horns from their forehead, similar to those found on bioengineered megaspiders. These horns can be used to maul enemies in combat if unarmed, but they also increase mining speed slightly.
Carriers of this gene have their Malpighian tubules set to overdrive and are capable of withstanding extreme amounts of toxicity without any ill effects.

Carriers of this gene do not suffer hypothermia. Instead, they enter hypothermic slowdown - a special biological state that allows them to survive extreme cold. Instead of trying to stay warm, the carrier’s body chemistry adapts to prevent internal freezing despite very low temperature. Bodily functions are slowed and capacities are reduced, but the cold does no permanent damage.
Carriers of this gene do not go through senescence in the normal way. They never get chronic age-related diseases like cancer, bad back, cataracts, or dementia, and age much slower.

Carriers of this gene have their exoskeleton consisting of thick, hardened chitin, and are much more resistant to damage and stagger effects. This comes at the cost of slowing them down slightly due to the sheer weight of the carapace.
Carriers of this gene have a volatile substance surrounding their brain, greatly increasing their psychic sensitivity.

Carriers of this gene produce large amounts of serotonin, keeping them in a continuous state of bliss while also affecting their consciousness. The presence of this neurotransmitter will also make them more aggressive.
Carriers of this gene produce a special kind of heatshock proteins when hot, allowing them to survive even the most extreme temperatures, but causing them to consume a lot more nutrition.
Carriers of this gene have large jelly sacks present on their lower abdomen, allowing them to periodically produce valuable insect jelly.

Carriers of this gene have large royal jelly sacks present on their lower abdomen. It increases their fertility and allows them to rapidly progress their pregnancy, and in case of chestburst pregnancies, it allows the carrier to carry their own spawn inside of them without the risk of death upon giving birth.

Carriers of this gene can self-impregnate, creating offspring without a second parent. Specialized reproductive organs generate a fetus internally, which is stored in an ovipositor-like structure until ready to be birthed. It enables carriers to rapidly propagate their species autonomously.

Carriers of this gene grow a thin cuticle exoskeleton shielding protecting them from any pathogens. This provides them with immunity to common illnesses such as malaria or flu. Does nothing to prevent the infection.

Carriers of this gene grow a singular, thick horn in the middle of their headbone, similar to the ones found on bioengineered spelopedes. Unlike the megaspider horns, spelopede horn cannot be used in combat, but it does increase mining speed greatly.

Carriers of this gene have long and deadly ripper-blades instead of hands. While the blades greatly lower work speed, they can be used in melee combat and are capable of ripping even armored enemies in half.

Carriers of this gene form a synaptic swarm, allowing their minds to link and accelerate learning when together. Like a hive of insects, their collective intelligence and speed of knowledge absorption increase with each additional member.

Carriers of this gene develop a specialized injector mouth, enabling them to administer royal jelly to others. This injection provides the recipient with an immunity boost and improved mood, though it leaves a tiny wound and can only be performed every six hours.
Carriers of this gene develop pyro-resistant chitin, drastically reducing their flammability and flame damage taken. They remain composed in fiery situations, never succumbing to panic when on fire.

Carriers of this gene possess flame glands, granting them the ability to spew combustible fluid from their mouths. This fluid ignites on contact, setting targets or surfaces ablaze, thanks to a special gland and sac that produce and store the fiery substance.
Carriers of this gene develop locust wings, granting them the special ability to perform a locust leap. This allows them to fly short distances, emulating the powerful and agile leaps of a locust.

Carriers of this gene possess an insect rostrum, a large, sharp beak-like structure akin to that of bees. This adaptation quadruples their eating speed and grants them a powerful melee bite attack, dealing significant stab damage with a quick cooldown.
Carriers of this gene develop acid glands, enabling them to spew acid from their neck, damaging buildings, people and items in a targeted area.
Carriers of this gene possess infrared sensors, allowing them to see clearly in the dark. They suffer no penalties to work speed or movement in darkness, and gain improved accuracy over long range.

Carriers of this gene develop mineral-rich insectskin, forming thick, protective plating on their skin. This natural armor provides significant protection until enough damage is sustained to break it.

Carriers of this gene develop large charger claws, granting them the ability to perform a charge towards a target, dealing significant damage to anything in their path and easily destroying defenses, with the ability to perform this action periodically and over a considerable distance.

Carriers of this gene have insect tissue for flesh. Consuming insect meat by them is classed as cannibalism. When butchered, they will yield insect meat instead of human meat.\n\nIf VFE - Insectoids 2 is present, this gene will negate the movement penalty on Creep.
Carriers of this gene emit special pheromones, allowing them to co-exist with wild insectoids. They will not be attacked by insectoids unless they are provoked.
Carriers of this gene have an optical arrangement composed of a single lens and without an elaborate retina, making them almost blind.

Carriers of this gene have their vocal cords changed into little openings in the bones, resulting in them being unable to speak, unless someone understands the loud whistling that they can now produce.
Carriers of this gene regenerate their tissue half as fast as normal and are much more likely to die from infection due to low immunity.
Carriers of this gene have hardened, less flexible joints, making it much harder to move and even harder to navigate difficult terrain.
Carriers of this gene have a very inefficient acid in their midgut, making it harder to absorb nutrients. They will become hungry significantly faster, but they will be able to consume more.
Carriers of this gene have hollow pores in their skin, making them look extremely unappealing.

Carriers of this gene are unable to process new information and are incapable of evaluating their decisions and learning from them. They are incredibly slow at learning new skills and knowledge, and have greatly lowered psychic sensitivity.
Carriers of this gene lack any capability to filter out toxins as their tubules have become functionless. They are much more likely to die due to any sort of toxicity in their environment.

Carriers of this gene enter a hibernation if their temperatures drop below a certain point for too long. They will rapidly lose their body functions and fall into a deep sleep, which prevents any sort of frostbite damages but also makes them unable to do anything.
Carriers of this gene have a short life cycle and will suffer age related illnesses sooner than others. The older they get, the more rapidly they will age.

Carriers of this gene have their exoskeleton consisting of thin, porous and brittle chitin, and are prone to damage. The light weight of their carapace, however, allows for a slightly faster movement speed.

Carriers of this gene experience heat stress when temperatures exceed their optimal range for physiological processes. This can lead to cellular damage, including denaturation of proteins, burn damage and a severe fear of fire. They will lose consciousness when exposed to extreme heat even for a short duration.

Carriers of this gene have reduced activity and aggression and spend most of their time in a dormant state. Metabolism of such an individual is also reduced, allowing them to consume less nutrition to keep themselves alive.
Carriers of this gene produce very little octopamine, causing decreased arousal and reducing their activity level. The lack of this neurotransmitter will also make them much more depressed.

Carriers of this gene need to be affected by pollution on a regular basis to survive. After 5 days without pollution, carriers will suffer from pollution deficiency. After 30 days, they will fall into a coma. After 60 days, they will die.

Carriers of this gene have disrupted cellular processes caused by denatured proteins that react dangerously to UV radiation. They are intensely sensitive to sunlight and have very dry chitin that’s susceptible to fire.
Carriers of this gene can only tolerate a very narrow range of temperatures.
Carriers of this gene have a highly concentrated toxin in their blood. When bleeding, they emit large amounts of tox gas, and upon death, their gear will be destroyed by acid.

Carriers of this gene exhibit a microsized stature, significantly smaller than their counterparts. Their reduced size results in increased stagger duration, lower meat and leather yield, and a smaller yet more efficient hunger requirement.

Carriers of this gene grow to colossal proportions, towering over their peers. Their immense size increases meat and leather yield and hunger needs, while reducing movement speed and melee dodge chance. If equipped with the right enhancements, they can carry the heaviest of weapons and warcasket armaments.

Carriers of this gene develop chemfuel sacks resembling a tail, drastically increasing their susceptibility to flame damage. If engulfed in large enough flames or upon death, they erupt in a fiery explosion. Additionally, they can be "milked" periodically to yield chemfuel.
Carriers of this gene possess a pyrophilic nature, exhibiting a fascination and love for fire. They are drawn to flames and find comfort and joy in their presence.

Carriers of this gene exhibit volatile behavior, drastically increasing their likelihood of initiating social fights and ensuring their mental breaks are always violent when possible. They have a heightened tendency to attempt prison breaks and will use weapons in social confrontations.

Carriers of this gene experience an ecdysone overdrive, creating a constant need for kill satiety. Prolonged periods without melee kills inflict increasing mood penalties, driving them towards violent confrontations to maintain their mental balance.

Carriers of this gene possess an acid burstsack, which triggers an explosive release of corrosive acid when they take a severe hit. This explosion affects everything within a wide radius, causing ongoing damage to those caught in the blast.
Carriers of this gene have solidified grey matter, resulting in a complete inability to learn new skills. They experience accelerated skill loss, which affects them even at lower skill levels.
Carriers of this gene have hardlocked joints, significantly slowing their movements. Their inflexible joints make bending and swift actions extremely difficult.
Carriers of this gene are inherently passive, showing no interest in and being unable to participate in combat. Their nature compels them to avoid violent confrontations entirely.

As the old, derelict ship entered the lower orbit, a sudden systems failure triggered a catastrophic malfunction. Not sure if it was due to the ship’s advanced age, a critical hardware failure, or a long-dormant virus in the AI-core, we quickly realized it didn’t matter. Our colony of insectors, long misunderstood and striving to survive, was in chaos. In our panic, we instinctively swarmed towards the escape pods, desperate to flee the impending disaster.

In our haste, we accidentally launched the pods, leaving the human crew behind in their cryptosleep chambers, unaware and doomed. The ship split into numerous chunks as it rapidly descended onto the surface. Amid the pandemonium, we could only hope that perhaps some things could still be recovered from the wreckage.

Note: Since you start crash landing and with very little supplies, this is a difficult scenario.

Insectors were engineered as a military project to thrive on planets with harsh, insectoid environments. They can edit their genes to form various castes suited to different conditions, making them highly adaptable and self-sufficient. Living in symbiosis with insectoids, they reproduce by implanting a chestburster larva into a host.\n\nWith chitinous exoskeletons, multifaceted eyes, and segmented limbs, Insectors resemble a blend of humans and insects. Their isolationist nature and unsettling appearance often lead others to see them as cold and unapproachable. However, their society is complex and strategic, using fear and misunderstanding to their advantage in diplomacy and warfare, ensuring their survival in the harshest conditions.

Engineered for harsh insectoid worlds, Insectors can adapt their genes to form specialized castes and reproduce through chestburster larvae. With chitinous exoskeletons and multifaceted eyes, they live in symbiosis with insectoids.
